Bridging this gap requires identifying, verifying, and engaging a significant number of experts across many, often niche, domains over an extended period of time. And the specificity matters: not a physician, but an investigator who has actually run a Phase III oncology trial; not a generalist consultant, but a reimbursement lead who has negotiated with payers. 

Guidepoint Labs' human data team is leading the way to solve exactly that problem for frontier model builders and researchers building frontier models, having access on day one to millions of vetted experts across effectively every industry and deep into the sub-specialties, along with mature governance, compliance, and confidentiality infrastructure.

Lightmatter raised $400 million in its Series D round, reaching a valuation of $4.4 billion. We will continue to accelerate the development of data center photonics and grow every department at Lightmatter!

jobs.title: Associate Claim Specialist
jobs.description_text:
Be part of something new: our Associate Claim Specialist training cohort starts January 4, 2027!

We’re excited to welcome five Associate Claim Specialists to MEMIC in a dedicated cohort, so you’ll learn alongside peers, build lasting relationships, and launch your claims career with structured support from day one. In this role, you will investigate, evaluate, and manage medical-only and low-complexity lost time claims, ensuring injured workers receive appropriate care and benefits while supporting policyholders and agents. With on-the-job training and opportunities for growth, this role is an ideal starting point for individuals seeking to develop expertise in workers’ compensation claims.

What You’ll Do

  • Claims Management: Investigate, evaluate, and resolve medical-only claims and low-complexity lost time claims.
  • Communication: Serve as a point of contact for insureds, injured workers, agents, brokers, attorneys, and other stakeholders to gather necessary information and provide timely updates.
  • Benefit Delivery: Administer medical and indemnity benefits in compliance with state workers’ compensation statutes and MEMIC’s best practices.
  • Quality Assurance: Maintain organized and high-quality claim files in accordance with company policies and procedures.

jobs.title: Co-Op, Bayesian Methods for Complex Decision Making
jobs.location_raw: Cambridge, MA USA; San Francisco, CA USA
jobs.description_text:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila Sciences builds AI systems that accelerate discovery across the physical and life sciences. Within Physical Sciences AI, we work with experimental teams to build autonomous discovery agents that decide which experiments Lila's AI Science Factories should run next.

Real scientific campaigns rarely look like textbook optimization problems. A single campaign can mix large discrete choices (which components, which recipe) with continuous settings (amounts, temperatures, times), pursue several objectives under hard constraints, and draw on evidence from literature and characterization data. Every experiment costs real time and materials. Off-the-shelf methods often struggle here, and they ignore the domain structure that could guide the search.

As a Bayesian Methods Co-Op, you will work alongside research scientists and engineers on a focused project within one broad question: how AI systems can make better experimental decisions. Depending on your background, that could mean building agents that choose the next experiment, testing when in-context learners can be trusted as decision-makers, or developing Bayesian strategies for tight experimental budgets. Your methods will be tested against live campaigns.

What You'll Be Building

  • Design and benchmark experiment-selection strategies that balance exploration and exploitation under realistic budgets
  • Build autonomous discove

You will work alongside scientists and engineers in a lab built for high-throughput, automated experimentation, and your protocols will feed directly into how these measurements get scaled.

jobs.description_text:
Somewhere out there, a subpoena is being served. It has twenty-seven document requests, a Kafkaseque set of instructions, and someone on the other end who would like it handled yesterday. Next week, there will be more.

You can grind through that kind of volume by burning through headcount and leaving no stone unturned. Or you can meet it with creativity and judgment, stepping back to focus on what is actually needed and building systems so the next hundred meet the quality bar more easily than the last.

Litigation at Mercury is not about posturing or perfection. It’s about getting the important things right and knowing which things those are. As a Litigation Paralegal, you’ll join Mercury’s litigation team at a pivotal moment in the company’s story, drawing on your experience and judgment to help the company continue to innovate and scale as it builds a modern banking* experience trusted by more than 450,000 customers.

About the role

You’ll be a key member of our litigation team, supporting work across subpoenas, law enforcement requests, demand letters, discovery, and related workflows. You’ll partner closely with the Deputy General Counsel, Litigation & IP and Senior Litigation Paralegal but operate with a high degree of autonomy—owning high-volume processes, driving execution, and developing creative solutions that enable the team to amplify its impact even as the company grows and scales.

About MSF USA | Doctors Without Borders

 

Doctors Without Borders/Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an independent international organization that provides medical care to the people who need it most. The organization cares for people affected by conflict, disease outbreaks, disasters, and social exclusion in more than 70 countries. MSF offers medical humanitarian assistance solely based on need, regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, or politics. Our international project teams include medical, logistical, and administrative staff, most of them hired locally and working with their own communities. Our actions are guided by medical ethics and the principles of independence, impartiality, and neutrality. We also bear witness and speak out about the experiences of our colleagues and patients. 
 
MSF USA is one of 24 sections supporting the global movement, primarily through staff recruitment, fundraising, advocacy, and communications. We welcome candidates who bring a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences to join us in working toward MSF’s social mission.
